readout_other: whole-cell patch clamp (current and voltage clamp) of bushy and stellate cells
direction_notes: 60 s LIUS increased excitability in both bushy and stellate cells, with stellate cells increasing firing rate and both cell types showing larger sodium and potassium currents.
safety_notes: Temperature in the recording chamber was monitored with a thermal infrared imager and rose by nearly 1 C during 60 s of stimulation.

exposures.label: On-chip SAW LIUS on AVCN slices

timing.protocol_description: 60-s continuous ultrasonic waves applied during recording; each cell was recorded Before, During and 10 min After LIUS.

source_quotes.exposures[0].fundamental_frequency_khz: In brief, a pair of interdigital transducers (IDTs) at the resonant frequency of 27.38 MHz in the chip was excited to generate surface acoustic waves (SAWs) and stimulate the neurons of brain slice located at a polydimethylsiloxane ring-shaped (PDMS, Sylgard 184, Dow Corning, Elizabethtown, KY, USA) recording chamber with relatively small input power.
source_quotes.exposures[0].timing.sonication_duration_: As shown in Fig. 1(a), the 60-s continuous ultrasonic waves following patch-clamp recording were generated by an arbitrary waveform generator (AFG 3102, Tektronix, Beaverton, OR, USA), amplified by a power amplifier (ZHL-1-2W , Mini-Circuits, Brooklyn, NY, USA), and then applied to both IDTs.
source_quotes.exposures[0].unspecified_domain.pressure: The displacement of the piezoelectric substrate perpendicular to the surface plane was 20 pm measured by a laser Doppler velocimetry (UHF-120 Ultra High-Frequency Vibrometer, Polytec, Waldbronn, Germany), and the acoustic pressure in the experiments was approximately 0.13 MPa (the spatial-peak time-average intensity (ISPTA) was evaluated to be approximately 465 mW/cm2) [34].
source_quotes.exposures[0].unspecified_domain.ispta_w_: The displacement of the piezoelectric substrate perpendicular to the surface plane was 20 pm measured by a laser Doppler velocimetry (UHF-120 Ultra High-Frequency Vibrometer, Polytec, Waldbronn, Germany), and the acoustic pressure in the experiments was approximately 0.13 MPa (the spatial-peak time-average intensity (ISPTA) was evaluated to be approximately 465 mW/cm2) [34].
source_quotes.exposures[0].device.model: An ultrasound neuromodulation chip was fabricated by the standard microelectromechanical systems (MEMS) processes with the advantages of the small size and transparent character and compatible with patch-clamp systems for stimulating slices in vitro [8].
